value.signature: fn evaluate (input : & TransportInput < Interval > , budget : & mut Budget , maximum_cells : usize ,) -> Result < TransportOutput < Interval > , KernelError >

review.body: { validate (input , maximum_cells , budget) ? ; let (normalized , raw) = products (input , budget) ? ; let emitted = emission (& raw , & input . emission , budget) ? ; let mut result = pairs (input , & emitted , budget) ? ; result . normalized = normalized ; result . raw = raw ; Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Only frozen public compiler inputs, rational coordinates, declared policies and checked numerical evidence enter these operations. The evaluator retains public bounds and operational Work, never private material or publication bytes; it neither changes a subscriber nor admits a digest.
